findings_resolved.label: Missing animate-pulse-ring class
findings_resolved.resolution: Added @keyframes pulse-ring and .animate-pulse-ring utility class to src/index.css inside @layer utilities.

findings_resolved.label: validatedAt overwritten at prep start
findings_resolved.resolution: Added prepStartedAt?: Timestamp to Order interface in src/types/index.ts. TicketCard.handleStart now writes prepStartedAt: Timestamp.now() instead of overwriting validatedAt. Countdown useEffect reads order.prepStartedAt ?? order.validatedAt as the anchor.

findings_resolved.label: orderCount never incremented
findings_resolved.resolution: OrderActions.handleValidate now calls incrementProductOrderCount(item.productId, item.quantite) for each item in order.items after successfully setting status to VALIDATED.

findings_resolved.label: Hardcoded Tables heading
findings_resolved.resolution: Added table.section_title key to both fr.json ("Tables") and en.json ("Tables"). ServeurDashboard now renders t('table.section_title') instead of the hardcoded literal.

findings_resolved.label: Catch-all maps every failure to wrong-credentials message
findings_resolved.resolution: LoginPage.handleSubmit catch block now checks err.message === 'no_user_doc' and shows t('auth.error_generic') for that case; all other errors (wrong credentials, Firebase auth errors) show t('auth.error_invalid').

findings_resolved.label: Logout buttons missing aria-label
findings_resolved.resolution: Added aria-label={t('nav.logout')} to the logout <button> in both ServeurDashboard and CuisineDashboard.
